visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a black button-up cardigan and grey sweatpants, stands in a brightly lit indoor living room. She holds up a large, thick scarf with blocks of pink, white, and grey. Digital sparkle effects appear at the bottom of the frame. (2) She demonstrates a standard scarf wrap by putting it around her neck once. She smiles and talks toward the camera, her hands moving to adjust the scarf against her chest. Behind her is a beige leather sofa and white furniture. (3) She transitions to the first styling technique. She wraps the scarf, pulls the ends through a loop, and then pulls the back part over her head to form a hood. She smiles widely and gives a thumbs-up gesture to the camera. (4) She resets and starts the second method. She creates a small gap in the wrap near her collarbone and tucks the loose end into it, fluffing the material. (5) For the third style, she starts with uneven lengths. She crosses them once, wraps the long end around her neck, and tucks it into the central loop. (6) In the final demonstration, she crosses the ends twice in front of her. She uses her fingers to pick out specific strands of the scarf's fringe and ties them together. Finally, she swings the entire scarf over her shoulders to create a cape-like wrap, adjusting the folds around her arms and chest while smiling.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 冬天要如何圍圍巾. (2) [Slogan]: 先示範：一般圍法. (3) [Subtitle]: 正常我們圍圍巾應該都這樣. (4) [Subtitle]: 其實我覺得這樣圍 也沒有不好看. (5) [Subtitle]: 我覺得只要你圍巾選得夠長 其實能做的造型就很多. (6) [Slogan]: 四種圍巾的造型圍法. [Slogan]: 第一個圍法. (7) [Subtitle]: 把外面兩條都塞進去洞洞. (8) [Subtitle]: 這樣就變成帽子圍巾. (9) [Subtitle]: 頭就不會吹到冷風 冬天就不會犯頭痛. (10) [Slogan]: 第二個圍法也很easy. [Slogan]: 先一般簡單圍. (11) [Subtitle]: 拉出一點洞洞 圍巾塞進去洞洞裡面. (12) [Slogan]: 完成. [Subtitle]: 超簡單. (13) [Subtitle]: 這真的不會就要打屁股了. (14) [Slogan]: 第三個圍法. [Slogan]: 一長一短 交叉一次 長的往後繞一圈 一樣有個洞洞 長的那條塞進洞洞裡. (15) [Slogan]: 完成. [Subtitle]: 真的超容易的大概 這個真的很好學. (16) [Slogan]: 最後一個主委加碼. [Slogan]: 交叉兩次. (17) [Subtitle]: 如果你的圍巾有鬚鬚線 各拿兩條出來綁起來 (這邊很隨性，有綁就好) 不用太緊 再來就是「往後甩」. (18) [Subtitle]: 稍微整理一下 這樣會變超級暖和 非常地舒服 也很像披著一件很暖的棉被 但完全不會厚重 而且肩膀完整被包覆住 真的會有一種很溫暖的感受 就這樣. (19) [Subtitle]: 好easy太簡單了大家.
